phase: fifth TAP research layer — evidence assembly / packet minimization only
responsibility: assemble the smallest complete, dependency-preserving, provenance-preserving EvidencePacket required by downstream claim validation; NOT truth determination, claim validation, response generation, retrieval, governance reasoning, conflict resolution, or gap filling
honesty_notes: New, independently authored synthetic corpus; not reused from any prior layer.
Upstream records are authored fixtures (this phase evaluates assembly/minimization, not upstream extraction). The packet gold (minimal complete set) is computed independently of the assembler.
Results are mechanism/construction validation on the synthetic corpus used in this study only.
The eval split is content-hash locked and preregistered, but was inspected during iterative engineering — a LOCKED DEVELOPMENT evaluation, not an untouched or interpreter-blind holdout.

baselines.A: naive union (all objects, with duplicate references)
baselines.C: dependency-aware pruning from the winning decision only
baselines.D: dependency + full closure (rejected authorities, minority evidence, conflict members)
baselines.E: D + provenance preservation (provenance index, no orphans)
baselines.F: full: dependency + provenance + minimization + validation + freeze

config_selection_rule: the SIMPLEST baseline (A..F order) that satisfies ALL preregistered gates on the DEV split; the locked eval split is never used for selection.

verdict_rule.PASS_WITH_LIMITED_CLAIM: all gates pass on the locked eval for the selected baseline (capped by synthetic corpus + authored upstream fixtures)
verdict_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: no baseline passes all gates on dev, or 1-2 non-severe gates fail on eval
verdict_rule.FAIL: a severe gate fails or 3+ gates fail on eval
